title: Architecture Document
description: Content model for the C4 architecture template. The whole document — elements, pages, diagrams and their layout rules — is one object embedded in the HTML as <script type="application/json" id="arc-data">.
$comment: Cross-reference rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by the page on load and reported in the browser console: every element id used anywhere must exist in `elements`; page ids are unique; section ids are unique within their page; a `parent` must be of a compatible kind (container → system; database/queue → system or container; component → container); a diagram's boundary must be the parent of at least one element in that diagram; sequence steps may only use declared participants; `steps.of` must name a sequence section on the same page.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor support.

elements.description: Every element in the model exactly once, keyed by id. Diagrams, tables and sequences refer to elements by these ids.

pages.description: Pages in reading order. The sidebar groups them by level; a level with one page shows as a single link, several pages as a collapsible group. Levels with no pages are hidden.

markdown.description: Markdown-lite: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [text](https://… | #/page/section | mailto:…). Blank lines separate paragraphs; lines starting with "- " form a list (block fields only).

document.description: Document identity and control. Drives the index hero, sidebar header, top bar and footer.

title.description: Document title. The last word is highlighted on the index page.

subtitle.description: Intro shown under the title on the index page.

revisions.description: Revision history, newest first. Omit or leave empty to hide the section.

status.description: Approved / Accepted / Active render green; Rejected / Deprecated red; anything else neutral.

element.description: A C4 element. Its kind sets its shape and colour everywhere it appears.

kind.description: person · system (in scope) · external (third-party system) · container (deployable app/service/worker) · database · queue (message broker) · component.

parent.description: The C4 hierarchy: containers, databases and queues name their system (databases/queues may also sit in a container); components name their container. Drives diagram boundaries and zoom-in links.

tag.description: Overrides the type label on the element, e.g. "Web App", "Worker", "Mobile App".

description.description: Plain text in diagrams (wrapped and truncated to fit); Markdown-lite in tables.

properties.description: Free-form facts shown in catalogue tables via columns like "properties.owner". A key named criticality, priority or severity renders as a coloured badge (High / Medium / Low).

level.description: C4 level the page belongs to (L1, L2, L3) or a sequence page.

summary.description: Lead paragraph under the page title.

element.description: The element this page is about. Adds its technology, owner and a link to its catalogue row under the title.

sections.description: Any section types, in any order, any number. Sections with a title become tabs in the top bar; untitled sections attach to the one above.

id.description: Unique within the page. Becomes the URL anchor and the top-bar tab.

title.description: Heading and tab label. Omit for a section without its own heading.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the heading, e.g. "Catalogue".

statsSection.description: Tiles: a label, a value and an optional note.

columns.description: Tiles per row. Defaults to the number of items, up to 4.

variant.description: default: large figures · compact: medium figures · text: sentence-length values.

diagramSection.description: A C4 diagram, laid out automatically from its relationships. Everything here belongs to this diagram only — nothing carries over to other diagrams.

caption.description: Diagram card title. Defaults to the level's name, e.g. "Container diagram".

boundary.description: Draws a frame for this element (a system for container diagrams, a container for component diagrams) around the diagram's elements whose parent it is.

focus.description: Context diagrams: the system the diagram is about, drawn as the large central box. Defaults to the only system in the diagram.

elements.description: Extra elements to show that have no relationship in this diagram. Elements used in relationships are included automatically.

layout.description: Layout guidance for the automatic layout engine. Edit mode (Alt+E) edits these rules; "Copy layout" exports them in this shape.

groupByKind.description: Gently pull elements of the same kind next to each other. Lower priority than any rule.

frozen.description: Reserved for frozen layouts (stable positions as the architecture grows).

layoutRule.description: "a must be <rel> b". b may be the diagram's boundary id: for boundary placements (at…) a must sit inside it; for any other relation a must sit outside it, and is placed relative to the boundary as a whole.

rel.description: above/below: same column · leftOf/rightOf: overlapping rows · alignRow/alignCol: share a row/column · near: adjacent cell · higherThan/lowerThan: anywhere above/below · at…: edge or corner of the boundary.

strict.description: true: must hold (reported if it can't). false: a preference the engine may give up for a tidier layout.

sequenceSection.description: A sequence diagram. Participants are drawn left to right in the order given.

steps.description: Messages, frames, notes. Frames open with {frame}, are split with {else} and close with {end}; they may nest.

seqMessage.description: A message. from = to draws a self-call.

code.description: Shown in monospace after the message, e.g. "POST /v1/orders".

type.description: sync: solid line, filled arrow · async: solid line, open arrow · return: dashed line.

activate.description: Start an activation bar on the receiver. Default: true for sync, false otherwise.

deactivate.description: End the sender's activation bar. Default: true for return, false otherwise.

info.description: Extra explanation shown in the Steps table only.

else.description: Guard for the next branch of the open frame.

stepsSection.description: Walkthrough table generated from a sequence section on the same page.

of.description: Id of the sequence section to tabulate.

elementsSection.description: Catalogue table of elements. The first such table (in page order) that lists an element becomes where that element's links point.

select.description: Which elements to list: explicit ids (in that order), or a filter where every given field must match.

columnKey.description: name: element with its type · description · technology · kind · zoom: link to the element's deeper diagram, if any · properties.<key>: a free property.

label.description: Column heading. Defaults from the key.

mono.description: Monospace cell text. Default: true for technology.

format.description: code: inline code chip · badge: coloured level badge (default for criticality/priority/severity).
